summary: Iter44 Prepare (Signals+Briefings consolidation) — 12/12 backend tests pass, full frontend flow verified end-to-end. Fixed one backend robustness bug: POST /api/contexts/{cid}/briefs returned 502 when Claude wrapped JSON output in ```json fences. Applied the same fence-stripping pattern used in plays.py + a prose fallback so a non-JSON answer is accepted as the brief body instead of 502'ing.

minor.issue: Originally 502'd when Claude returned JSON inside a markdown code-fence. Fixed inline by stripping fences + prose fallback (same pattern as /plays). 12/12 tests now pass.

critical_code_review_comments: prepare.py now fence-strips LLM output and falls back to raw text if JSON parse fails — matches existing pattern in routers/plays.py. Consider extracting _safe_parse_json() into a shared util (llm_service or a new helpers/llm_json.py) so the next LLM-JSON endpoint doesn't repeat this boilerplate.
BriefIn.objective has min_length=8 validation; the UI disables submit at <8 chars as well, but there's no server-side max-char guard beyond Pydantic's 600. Consistent with other routers. Fine.

SignalsTab reuses the existing /signals/generate endpoint and just prefixes focus with a '[filter_label]' marker — it doesn't persist filter_label as a first-class field on the signal doc. If filter-based history filtering is on the roadmap, consider adding a dedicated `filter` field to the signals collection instead of string-prefixing.
seed_data_creation: Test brief created during UI flow was deleted via the trash icon; no residual TEST_ data left on Tuli CFO ctx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest iter44 at /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_prepare.py covers all 5 brief CRUD endpoints + kinds endpoint + 422-on-unknown-kind + signals/briefings/home regression. The earlier 502 on POST /briefs has been resolved via fence-strip fallback in prepare.py lines ~101-120. UI flow verified on Tuli Financial Group (CFO) exec ctx (id 2ceb9fde-...) — but the test is generic and works on any ctx. Sidebar 'Prepare' nav is at data-testid='nav-prepare'. Redirects /app/highlights and /app/briefings both land on /app/prepare. Brief generation LLM call takes ~10-12s; plan for >=15s wait in any Playwright scripts. SignalDetailModal was not exercised via UI because the test didn't trigger a signal generation — backend regression test covers the endpoint; UI inline-modal behaviour is source-verified at Prepare.jsx line 449.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the 502 on /briefs: prepare.py did json.loads on the raw LLM response, but Claude (despite an 'IMPORTANT: respond with valid JSON only' nudge) sometimes wraps JSON in ```json ... ``` fences. The parse silently failed, parsed={}, md_body='', and the router raised 502. Mitigation: strip common fences before parsing (same pattern as routers/plays.py:457-464) + fallback to treating the whole raw text as the brief body if it's long enough, rather than losing the user's LLM-generated content to a 502. No data change needed.
